verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports confirm that Ollama ships its own desktop app for macOS and Windows, and that it can be used to chat with local models. Users say it is simple, with working multimodal and Markdown support. The docs also refer to opening the Ollama app on macOS. However, the app is not available on Linux, cannot connect to a remote Ollama instance, and first-party documentation of the chat GUI is thin. Missing for 10: Linux GUI support, first-party documentation of the chat interface's features, remote-instance connectivity.
